payload.claim: The Home Office accepts only SELTs from approved providers.
payload.quote: The UK Home Office only accepts SELTs from approved providers.

payload.claim: IELTS for UKVI Academic or General Training is suitable for student visas.
payload.quote: IELTS for UKVI (Academic or General Training) Suitable for student visas, work visas, and other general immigration routes

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI is a fully computer-based test approved by UKVI.
payload.quote: PTE Academic UKVI is a fully computer-based English language test approved by UKVI.

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI offers quick results, often within 48 hours.
payload.quote: Applicants looking for a fast and efficient testing process with quick results (often within 48 hours)

payload.claim: In 2018, 85.7% of PTE Academic test takers got results within 2 days.
payload.quote: In fact, during 2018, 85.7% of PTE Academic test takers received their results within just 2 days.

payload.claim: Some PTE scores take longer than 2 days because of extra review or security checks.
payload.quote: Our system sometimes flags results for additional review which can take more time.

payload.claim: IELTS is accepted by over 13,500 organisations while only around 3,000 accept PTE.
payload.quote: In fact, over 13,500 organisations worldwide trust IELTS’ evaluation of English language skills while only around 3,000 organisations accept the PTE.

payload.claim: IELTS is claimed to be favoured over PTE by most.
payload.quote: As IELTS is the world’s number one English test for migration, it is still favoured over the PTE by most.

payload.claim: PTE is computer-only while IELTS offers paper or computer.
payload.quote: This is because the PTE is available only on computer, whereas with IELTS you will have the flexibility to choose between taking your test on computer or paper in many locations globally.

payload.claim: UKVI Academic versions of both IELTS and PTE are accepted for UK study.
payload.quote: If you want to further their studies in the UK, the UKVI Academic version of both the IELTS and PTE are accepted.

payload.claim: SELT list for qualifications after 6 April 2015 includes IELTS UKVI, Trinity ISE (in UK), PTE Academic and LanguageCert International ESOL.
payload.quote: Pearson Test of English Academic (PTE Academic)

payload.claim: Universities may accept non-SELT qualifications as English evidence.
payload.quote: The government allows universities to accept achievement in non-SELT qualifications as evidence of English language proficiency.

payload.claim: As of September 2026 approved SELTs also include LanguageCert and PSI Skills for English UKVI (outside UK).
payload.quote: PSI: Skills for English UKVI (outside the UK).

payload.claim: For degree-level study B2 is needed; universities that are HEPs may assess English themselves, so TOEFL iBT, Duolingo, Cambridge C1 can be accepted.
payload.quote: This is why universities can accept tests that are not SELTs, such as TOEFL iBT, the Duolingo English Test or Cambridge C1 Advanced.

payload.claim: A SELT result must be awarded within two years before application.
payload.quote: The result must have been awarded in the two years before the date you apply.

payload.claim: IELTS for UKVI has same content as standard IELTS; only booking and centre differ.
payload.quote: IELTS for UKVI uses the same Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking papers as IELTS Academic or General Training.
It is not a SELT, so it cannot be used where the Home Office asks for one.

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI is accepted by the Home Office for all UK visas.
payload.quote: Our Secure English Language test, PTE Academic UKVI, is accepted by the UK’s Home Office for all UK visas to test your four language skills – including the Skilled Worker visa.
